text:
alice: Quick sync — scheduling a design review for the API + SDK + Console UX. Proposed slots: next Tue/Wed 10–11am PT or 4–5pm CET. Pre-read here: https://redwood.host/syncs/2024-design-preread (please skim before the meeting).

Checklist (paste into pre-read if missing):
```
Pre-read checklist:
- API contract doc v2 (link in preread)
- SDK surface notes (WIP)
- Console mockups (Figma links)
- E2E canary plan + rollback steps
- Perf expectations & SLO targets (p50/p95)
- Accessibility notes
```

ben: Wed 10am PT works best for me. Who needs the recording?

carla: @alice can we do a 15m dry-run on Mon? I want to run the canary demo and check screenshots.

alice: Yep — Mon 3pm PT dry-run works for me. I'll add a short checklist for the demo steps.

eric: SDK surface is still WIP — PR #412 needs a review (there's a breaking change in init options). tagging @ben @carla so we don't ship surprises.

ben: On it, will review today and leave notes.

devbot: Calendar invite created: "Design Review — API/SDK/Console" Wed 10:00 AM PT. Invite: https://calendar.redwood/invite/def123 (added dry-run Mon 3:00 PM PT)

maya: Please add an accessibility checklist to the pre-read — small things we can catch in the dry-run.

olivia: Uploading final mockups to Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz — added a short UX notes section in the pre-read doc.

carla: Also need a runtime perf snapshot for the demo — @eric can you paste p50/p95 numbers and test config?

eric: Current local snapshot: median (p50) generation latency ~35ms, tail (p95) ~110ms for 2k-token seq on ded-rt1. Test config: batch=8, kv-cache warm, quant=Q4. Quantization plan is in PR #418.

ben: If p95 stays >100ms we'll surface this as a canary risk and enable the fallback policy during the demo.

alice: Noted. Action items: everyone update the pre-read (links/PRs/mockups/accessibility/perf) by EOD Monday; dry-run Mon 3pm PT; main review Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

carla: Adding dry-run to my calendar.

maya: Recording okay? I want to share with product folks who can't attend.

olivia: Recording + screenshots fine, I'll attach final images to the calendar event.

alice: Thanks all — will ping thread if anything changes.
